title: padus serrulata
intro: Padus serrulata, commonly known as Pagoda Tree or Japanese Flowering Cherry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Padus serrulata include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as hypertension and atherosclerosis. The bioactive constituents of Padus serrulata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
